# SpiderCursor

> Lightweight, framework-agnostic, procedural 8-legged spider cursor effect rendered in Three.js with realistic inverse kinematics, real-time drop shadows, and zero external assets.

## Overview
- **Name**: SpiderCursor
- **Website**: https://spidercursor.techhive.net/
- **Category**: Open Source Web Graphics / Procedural Animation Library
- **License**: Apache-2.0
- **Author**: AJ Batac
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ajbatac/spidercursor
- **Key Characteristics**: Zero external 3D models (0 GLTF/OBJ), zero image spritesheets, pure mathematical procedural geometry, procedural Web Audio API step clicks, click-through non-blocking UI (`pointer-events: none`).

## Quick Installation

### CDN / HTML One-Liner
```html
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/spider-cursor@1.0.0/dist/spider-cursor.umd.js"></script>
<body onload="SpiderCursor.init({ theme: 'auto', size: 1.0, speed: 1.2, mode: 'hunt', webSilk: true })">
```

### NPM / ES Modules
```bash
npm install spider-cursor three
```
```ts
import { SpiderCursor } from 'spider-cursor';
const spider = new SpiderCursor({ theme: 'auto', mode: 'hunt' });
```

### React / Next.js
```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { SpiderCursor } from 'spider-cursor';

export function SpiderBackground() {
  const spiderRef = useRef<SpiderCursor | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    spiderRef.current = new SpiderCursor({ theme: 'auto', size: 1.0 });
    return () => spiderRef.current?.destroy();
  }, []);
  return null;
}
```

## Behavior Modes
- `hunt`: Smoothly tracks and stalks the user's cursor while maintaining a configurable stop distance.
- `flee`: Scurries away in panic whenever the cursor gets close.
- `wander`: Autonomously explores the viewport independently of the cursor.
- `perch`: Stays dormant until startled by a click or `spider.scare()`.

## Core Configuration Options (`SpiderConfig`)
- `size`: number (default: 1.0, range: 0.5-2.5) - Scale multiplier for body and leg lengths.
- `speed`: number (default: 1.0, range: 0.2-3.0) - Movement and gait cadence speed multiplier.
- `theme`: 'auto' | 'light' | 'dark' | 'custom' - Adapts to OS dark mode or custom hex palette.
- `mode`: 'hunt' | 'flee' | 'wander' | 'perch' - Active behavioral pattern.
- `stopDistance`: number (default: 38) - Minimum distance in pixels from cursor when hunting.
- `webSilk`: boolean (default: true) - Draws trailing silk line from spinnerets.
- `pointerEventsNone`: boolean (default: true) - Ensures clicks pass through to page elements.
- `sound`: boolean (default: false) - Procedural chitin footstep audio via Web Audio API.
- `maxFps`: number (default: 60) - Framerate cap for GPU efficiency.
- `pauseWhenHidden`: boolean (default: true) - Automatically pauses render loop on tab switch.
